name: clickup
description: Universal /clickup skill for creating and managing ClickUp tickets with enforced quality standards — Connextra user stories, evidence-only descriptions, fuzzy list aliases, first-name teammate resolution, duplicate detection, idempotent create, and a two-step onboarding wizard. Works over any ClickUp transport (ClickUp MCP, the clickup-cli binary, or the raw REST API) through one configurable connection layer: on first use it investigates what's available, asks which transport to use, and remembers the choice (/clickup:connect) — nothing about the transport is hardcoded.
